units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:5">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>חברא קרייך חמרא א׳ וכ׳</he> if thy neighbor calls thee an ass, put a saddle on.

<cite ref="Eruvin 27a:8">Erub. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>גבא דא׳</he> the upper part of the saddle (Ar., besides other var., <he>גברא דא׳</he> man’s figure on the upper part of the saddle) used as a handle by the rider.
